description: Welcome to Rasheed FieldShift! We are tackling "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" right here in Azare. Our goal is to build an easy-to-use web tool combining NASA climate and soil moisture data with local farming knowledge to help farmers compare smart crop-rotation strategies. Looking for 3–5 teammates in Azare: web/frontend developers, Python/data analysts, UI/UX designers, and agriculture researchers/presenters. All skill levels welcome!
